A REVISED VERSION OF AN EARLIER MANUSCRIPT, as its own public supplementary files show: they are named dual_beatty_v21_check.py, dual_beatty_v21_log2_3_r1_600.csv and dual_beatty_v21_RF_sqrt6_sqrt11_r2_200.csv. Its content, all public: organised around the marked-rotation statistic, R^G = E N_c(X) and R^F = P(N_c(X) = 1) (Proposition 10); Open Problem 33 on the distribution of N_c beyond its mean and on the upper-family envelope for alpha > 2; asymptotic scale as Proposition 34, with the explicit factor rho_alpha^(delta_r).

READ at abstract and main-result level 21 September 2026, 30 pages, dated 13 September 2026, from literature/sources/winkler-2026-marked-rotations-2026-09-13.pdf; doi 10.13140/RG.2.2.22015.57761. The entry previously said 'read only to the extent it is public' and carried no URL. CONTENT. For irrational alpha > 1 and m_r = floor(alpha r), two opposite families of positive compositions constrained by the Beatty boundary m_r, counted by f_r(alpha) and c_r(alpha), the upper family ending at m_r and the lower at the crossing level. Their enumeration is governed by the number of cyclic starting positions satisfying the prefix inequalities. MAIN RESULT: the maximum number of admissible cyclic markings equals the ADDITIVE FACTORIZATION HEIGHT of a boundary point in the associated Beatty lattice -- a direct link between cyclic composition counting and the geometry of ONE-SIDED DIOPHANTINE APPROXIMATION. Consequence: the midpoint identity f_r + c_r = (2/r) binom(m_r - 1, r - 1) is classified completely, holding exactly at the record indices q_k of frac(alpha n), their doubles 2 q_k, and the sums q_k + q_(k+1) of consecutive record indices. That classification is the larger family this register recorded as having no counterpart here; the earlier note that it 'adds 2 q_k and q_k + q_(k+1)' is confirmed from the text. SCOPE OF THIS READING: abstract, introduction and the stated main result and consequence. The 30-page body was not read line by line and no claim is made about its proofs. It is the general theory that winkler-2026-admissible-qx1-sequences deliberately avoids, so if the Paper B oscillation is to be compared with anything at full strength, it is this.
